description: Golden reference for calc_accel_magnet.py on the C-type dipole em_sample.jou (half-z model, linear mu_r=1000).
rationale: Knowledge accumulation mechanism (per user feedback 2026-04-24 about losing working implementations): locks the end-to-end path yoke.jou -> export netgen (with Auto-Kelvin quarter-detected -> full z-cut kelvin pair) -> NGSolve Mesh + BBBND GND via CD3 propagation -> FEM Omega-reduced + Kelvin periodic -> B_origin + W_mag + L.  Any regression in the Cubit plugin's nodeset/sideset export, in add_periodic_kelvin fallback, or in calc_accel_magnet's Dirichlet setup will trip this test.

sample.generator_cmd_note: Regenerate via Cubit batch: python-run em_sample.jou + auto_add_kelvin_from_current_model() + export netgen order=1 overwrite.  Land .vol directly at src/radia/panels/samples/em_sample.vol (shipped with the wheel via pyproject.toml package-data).  Reference template: C:/temp/kelvin_bench/regen_em_sample.py.

geometry_note: Half-y model: yoke in y=[0, 0.18] only (no y-reflection in mesh; physically the reference is quarter-XZ with mesh reduced further).  Comparing to the C-type electromagnet quarter-XZ -228.1 mT reference requires setting up sym_tangential/sym_normal BCs AND porting the C-type electromagnet racetrack-coil geometry to a CoilBuilder script (Y_CENTER=131.25 mm vs em_sample_coil's 151.25 mm) -- that variant lives in the future em/em_elf_quarter_xz.jou.

observations.note: Absolute-value snapshot for regression guard.  EM panel accepts .py only (2026-04-25 policy); em_sample_coil.build_coil() returns an ELF-LIKE (NOT ELF-matched) racetrack with 4 straight + 4 arc CoilBuilder segments (8 Radia objects, 84 wire segments) at NI=2000.  Not matched to the ELF CEFC 2020 quarter-XZ Radia-MSC reference (-228.1 mT); see src/radia/panels/samples/em/README.md for the variant plan.  Mesh topology lock refreshed 2026-04-26 after `_add_kelvin_cubit_reduction` deterministic-anchor fix and after relocating the canonical .vol to the shipped path `src/radia/panels/samples/em_sample.vol` (was C:/temp/em_sample.vol, regen-only): ne 456477 -> 456476, ndof 83798 -> 83797 (drift 1).  Physics expected unchanged within tolerance.
